unchanged: All vertex positions, normals, UV/colors, indices, materials, scene/bone transforms, and every sampled channel in all nine clips are byte-identical. Only pendant skin joint indices and weights changed.
method: The editable frozen Blender source has a pendant-only vertex-group edit. Only the corrected pendant JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 accessors from a real Blender export were transplanted into the frozen GLB, avoiding unrelated remesh/tessellation changes.

discardedFullRebuild.scope: Discarded full rebuild vs accepted frozen hide; final delivered patch does not contain these changes
discardedFullRebuild.conclusion: The rebuild is not byte-identical. Actual position changes are limited to floating-point roundoff (0.267 micrometres local); triangle connectivity is equivalent after nearest-vertex correspondence; raw index changes are ordering only. The entire rebuild was discarded, so none of those changes enter the delivered narrow patch.

reproducibility.baselineStorage: No duplicate GLB is shipped. Its original neck-only pendant accessors can be restored losslessly from the delivered artifact and accepted only after matching the exact frozen baseline SHA256.
reproducibility.checks: Candidate pendant vertex count/order and all nonweight vertex attributes match exactly; joint ordering, rest transforms and inverse bind matrices match; output compares byte-for-byte with the delivered a48d6664 asset.
